_about: The organizations we follow. Hand-edited — this is the one file you touch for groups. Each entry: id (stable slug), name, what (why we care, one line), where (address or neighborhood), site, calendar (their own events page), feed (optional: how the build tool reads their calendar — type tribe|ics|jsonld|boswell|rss; leave it out for link-only orgs), kind (default kind for their events when a listing gives no better clue: music theater comedy film art talks books markets outdoors food sports family community), reach (walk|bus|car from home, used the same way), tags. tools/milwaukee/build.py reads this and writes events.json; it never writes this file. Started 2026-09-13 from the old community/events notes — prune and add freely.

orgs.name: UWM Philosophy
orgs.what: Her department. Colloquia and talks, most in Curtin Hall.

orgs.name: UW–Milwaukee
orgs.what: The campus-wide calendar: lectures, Peck School concerts and plays, Panthers games.

orgs.name: Boswell Book Company
orgs.what: The East Side bookstore, a walk down Downer. Author events most nights; some move to the Riverside or the Oriental.

orgs.name: Urban Ecology Center
orgs.what: Riverside Park branch is the neighborhood's back yard, at the river end of Park Place. Outings, volunteer days, gear lending. Their calendar is app-rendered, so it opens on their site.

orgs.name: Milwaukee Public Library
orgs.what: East Branch on Cramer is the local one; Central downtown is the grand one. Events run through their Communico calendar.

orgs.name: Milwaukee Film
orgs.what: Runs the Oriental on Farwell: the festival, repertory nights, year-round programming. Feed carries their announcements; showtimes are on the theatre page.

orgs.name: Milwaukee Art Museum
orgs.what: The Calatrava on the lake. Drop-in tours, talks, story time, MAM After Dark.

orgs.name: Woodland Pattern Book Center
orgs.what: Riverwest poetry and small-press center: readings, workshops, a reading group.

orgs.name: Milwaukee Turners
orgs.what: The 1853 gymnastics-and-democracy society at Turner Hall: climbing gym, public forums, the restaurant's fish fry. Their public Google calendar is only the citywide fitness-class schedule, so events open on their site.
orgs.where: Turner Hall, 1034 N Vel R. Phillips Ave

orgs.name: Mitchell Park Domes
orgs.what: Three glass domes on the near South Side: shows, plant sales, the winter farmers market.

orgs.name: Historic Milwaukee, Inc.
orgs.what: Walking tours all year and Doors Open Milwaukee in late September. Tours book through FareHarbor, so their page is the calendar.

orgs.name: Milwaukee Makerspace
orgs.what: Member workshop in Bay View with public open nights. Feed carries their posts.

orgs.name: Radio Milwaukee 88Nine
orgs.what: The music station in Walker's Point: live sessions, a community calendar, the Fall Ball.
